concerns.text: Tasks T052-T056 mandate implementing 'Hückel Molecular Orbital (HMO) theory' and calculating 'resonance_energy' using fixed physical constants (1.39 Å vs 1.54 Å). This violates Constitution Principle VI (Graph Descriptor Transparency) which mandates descriptors be generated by RDKit, and exceeds FR-001/FR-008 which only authorize 'topological proxies' and 'aromaticity indices'. This is unauthorized scope creep introducing a custom quantum-mechanical approximation not in the spec.

Tasks T015, T020-T022 require 'bond_polarity' and 'resonance_energy' descriptors derived from 'bond-order annotations' and 'electronegativity differences'. FR-001 explicitly lists the required descriptor set (degree distribution, path length, ring count, conjugation length, aromaticity indices). These tasks implement features not mapped to any Functional Requirement, creating orphan work that violates the constraint that tasks must satisfy specific FRs/SCs.

Task T039 mandates an 'iterative retraining loop' that retrains the model after *every* VIF feature exclusion. FR-013 and Plan Phase 4 only require retraining on the *reduced* feature set after filtering. The iterative approach introduces a performance risk (potentially violating FR-010 6-hour limit) without spec authorization, constituting a silent relaxation of the performance constraint via unverified complexity.

Task T008 implements 'scaffold splitting' but fails to specify the 'molecular scaffold' definition (e.g., Murcko scaffolds) required by FR-002 and Plan Phase 4. Without this explicit definition, the task allows an implementation that may fail to prevent data leakage, violating the semantic intent of FR-002.

Task T026 implements a fallback to 'HOMO-LUMO gap' if 'conductivity' is missing. While the Plan (Summary) authorizes this, the Spec (FR-003) strictly mandates training on 'charge carrier mobility... or intrinsic conductivity'. The task implements a target variable change that contradicts the Spec's FR-003 without an explicit Spec amendment, violating the constraint that tasks must not silently relax or contradict the Spec.
